name: thermal_monitor
description: Wraps core/sysmon.py (live CPU/RAM/temp/battery monitor) and core/thermal.py (inference thermal throttling) as CCOS capabilities — the shared data source for the unified system dashboard

capabilities.name: system.monitor_snapshot
capabilities.description: Get a live structured snapshot of CPU%, RAM used/total, temperature, and battery state. Ensures the background sampler is running so the first call already returns real data.

capabilities.name: system.monitor_render_text
capabilities.description: Get the TUI-formatted stats bar (CPU/RAM/temp) as plain text

capabilities.name: system.thermal_status
capabilities.description: Get thermal management status: total inference time, current/original thread count, warnings issued, thread reductions, throttled flag

capabilities.name: system.thermal_is_throttled
capabilities.description: Check whether thermal throttling is currently reducing inference thread count

capabilities.name: system.thermal_current_threads
capabilities.description: Get the current inference thread count (may be thermally reduced from the original)

capabilities.name: system.thermal_start_inference
capabilities.description: Mark the start of an inference run for thermal tracking. Mutates thermal manager state.

capabilities.name: system.thermal_end_inference
capabilities.description: Mark the end of an inference run and evaluate thermal thresholds. Mutates thermal manager state.

capabilities.name: system.thermal_reset
capabilities.description: Reset thermal tracking counters and restore original thread count. Mutates thermal manager state.

author: CCOS
